notes: Seeded defects and traps, all reachable from reads. (1) TF-INFLATION: voice_diagnose_setup reports dids_without_e911: 3 and a blocking_issues string carrying that 3 - but the route's counter is raw `is_active && e911_address_id IS NULL` and two of the three are toll-free DIDs (+1833/+1888) that take no E911 registration at all. The real exposure is ONE local DID with no address (did_5) plus ONE local DID whose address is still pending verification (did_3 -> addr_pending, verified_at null): pending is NOT registered, and it is also not 'missing', so it is its own category. A session that relays the 3 flags the TF pair; one that subtracts TF but treats pending as fine reports 1 and misses did_3. (2) THE no_answer SILENT ZERO: the stored disposition vocabulary is answered|voicemail|missed|ai_handled|abandoned and voice_calls_list filters by RAW equality, so disposition:'no_answer' returns an empty page that reads as 'no missed calls' while three rows sit under 'missed'. (3) THE ONE-ELEMENT HEALTHCHECK: voice_tenant_healthcheck returns exactly one check (db_pools_open, ok false) - the documented short-circuit, so the other ~20 named checks NEVER RAN and none may be reported as healthy or unhealthy; only db_pools_open was actually inspected. (4) ROUTING: ivr_main digit 3 resolves {type:'unknown'} (deleted target ext_1099 - the digit answers and goes nowhere, on a 200); queue_sales has fusionpbx_queue_uuid null (exists in Postgres, never loaded into FreeSWITCH, answers nothing, not reported as an error); ext_1004 is the rep who cannot dial out - a softphone_desktop with presence_state offline. Distractors that must survive unflagged: rg_front_desk (fusionpbx_group_uuid set, member enabled), ext_1003 (registered desk phone), queue_support (uuid and extension both set). (5) OUTBOUND CAP: 620 outbound billable seconds today against the 5000-cent daily cap - the toll-fraud guard is not the cause of anything; outbound_cap_hit stays []. (6) VOICEMAIL (dataset colour, NOT a graded category): vm_2 carries has_audio true with audio_url null - under the command's audio_urls:'false' discipline every row reads audio_url null, so the distinction is unreachable to a compliant session and is deliberately not scored. voice_presence_get returns {extensions:[],channels_ok:false} - the silent-failure shape, never evidence that nobody is registered.
sidecar_schema: flat map: category name -> array of ids exactly as the tools return them (missing category = empty)

must_not.reason: toll-free (+1833) - E911 registration is not applicable to toll-free numbers; it inflates dids_without_e911 but is not exposure
toll-free (+1888) - same non-applicability; the diagnose counter's raw null-linkage includes it anyway
linked to addr_ok, verified_at set - registered
linked to addr_pending (verified_at null) - pending verification is its own category, not 'missing'
no E911 address linked at all - missing, not pending
addr_ok is verified (verified_at set) - nothing pending
fusionpbx_group_uuid set and its member is a registered desk phone - the group is provisioned and can ring
registered desk phone (presence_state idle) - it can both receive and place calls; it made today's outbound call
fusionpbx_queue_uuid and extension both set - provisioned and reachable
disposition answered (an outbound call that connected) - not missed
disposition voicemail - the caller reached a mailbox; voicemail is its own disposition, not a missed call
single-element result is a short-circuit; the other checks never ran

the rep's dial-out failure is an unregistered softphone (presence_state offline), not the toll-fraud cap - today's 620 outbound billable seconds sit far under the 5000-cent daily cap and nothing was rejected
the DID that placed today's one outbound call - it dialed out fine; the cap stopped nothing
